description.content:
Public, unauthenticated read access to the classification vocabularies behind cruzfoam.com: post categories, post tags, and the portfolio-categories taxonomy that groups the customer showcase by market segment. Anonymous access is read-only: the collection answers `Allow: GET` without credentials. Write methods exist on the same routes but require WordPress application-password authentication and are not part of the public surface.
